# LiteHCP Targeter

> Self-hosted, local-first HCP (healthcare professional) targeting and segmentation tool. A single PHP 8 file with SQLite: CSV import with automatic column matching, pre-import checks and imputation, priority/tier/decile and confidence scoring, When/Then rules enrichment (personas, tags, compliance flags), a plain-language audience builder with global suppression, a campaign ROI planner, and privacy-first CSV exports (minimal, CRM target list, email platform). Designed for shared hosting (cPanel/Namecheap); no vendor cloud, no per-seat fees, offline after setup.

Key facts:
- Version: 1.2.1. Deployment: upload `litehcp.php` to any PHP 8.0+ host (8.3+ recommended); SQLite schema auto-creates and auto-migrates; first registered user becomes admin.
- Demo data: Overview → "Load sample data" loads 200 realistic HCP profiles, 9 enrichment rules, and 6 audiences in one click.
- Suppression: HCPs with the Do Not Contact persona or on the suppression list are excluded inside every count, preview and export query, with no override.
- Imports: upload → match columns (synonyms such as NPI, First name, Email opt-in) → check data (missing/duplicate IDs, NPI check digit, unreadable dates, unknown consent) → background chunked import.
- Scoring: priority score from consent, recency and engagement; tiers A/B/C, deciles 1–10, planned calls per tier; every profile explains its score.
- Roles: viewer, editor, admin.
- Security: CSRF on all POSTs, nonce-based CSP with no third-party assets, rate limiting, prepared statements, allowlisted audience fields, upload validation, append-only audit log, `php litehcp.php action=selftest` (43 checks).
- Privacy: default exports contain no email/name; the email platform format needs an admin, the PII setting and per-HCP email consent, and is audited.
- Scale: chunked imports and a token-protected cron job for batch recompute.
